name: ai4s-literature-fulltext
display_name: AI4S Literature Workbench: OA-first full-text fetch and PDF verification
description: OA-first full-text fetch and PDF verification; no Zotero credentials or institutional login.
long_description: The independent fulltext server of the AI4S Literature Workbench. It uses public HTTP/HTTPS OA routes (PMC lookup plus explicit candidate URLs), verifies main-article PDFs, and creates private hashed handoffs. It never handles Zotero credentials or institutional login. Storage paths, PDF size limits and HTTP timeouts use the server's automatic per-user defaults; no setup settings or keys are required.
